raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Strength Return-to-Ski (Post-Meniscus)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build lower-body and core strength for safe return to skiing with low-impact constraints"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Tissue Capacity" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength (Intro)":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press high_foot_position 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat_short_range front_foot_elevated 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lying_hamstring_curl 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          sled_push_light 4x20m rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_paloff_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Push/Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          chest_supported_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          half_kneeling_single_arm_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x30s_each rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10_each rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_doorway_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body Strength + Balance":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles 4x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 3x10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          step_up_low_box controlled 3x8_each rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_hamstring_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_anti_rotation_walkout 3x8_each rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength (Progressive)":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press high_foot_position 4x8 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat_short_range front_foot_elevated 3x8_each rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          lying_hamstring_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          sled_push_moderate 4x20m rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          paloff_press_iso 3x20s_each rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Push/Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          chest_supported_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          wide_grip_seated_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank_hip_abduction 3x20s_each rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10_each rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body Strength + Balance":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles 4x5 rpe 7..8 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 3x10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          step_up_low_box controlled 3x10_each rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          seated_hamstring_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_anti_rotation_walkout 3x10_each rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body Strength (ISOs + Control)":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press high_foot_position 4x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7..8 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat_iso_top_half 3x20s_each rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          lying_hamstring_curl 4x8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          sled_push_moderate 5x20m rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          paloff_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 5x4 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          chest_supported_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 3x40s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          cable_face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation_drill 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower Body Strength + Balance":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 4x8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          step_up_low_box controlled 3x10_each rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          seated_hamstring_curl 3x10 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          single_leg_balance_reach 3x6_each rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength (Deload)":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press high_foot_position 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat_short_range 2x8_each rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lying_hamstring_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          sled_push_light 3x20m rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          paloff_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper Body Deload":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          chest_supported_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x30s rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Lower Body Deload + Balance":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles 3x3 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 2x10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          step_up_low_box 2x8_each rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_hamstring_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          single_leg_balance_reach 2x6_each rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
  PHASE "Phase 2: Strength & Force Control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body Strength (Knee-Friendly)":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 4x6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          step_up_moderate_box controlled 4x6_each rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          nordic_curl_assisted 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          paloff_press_walkout 3x8_each rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body Strength + Anti-Rotation":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_barbell_press 5x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          weighted_pullup_or_assisted 5x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          single_arm_cable_row_split_stance 3x8_each rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_dumbbell_press_seated 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          half_kneeling_paloff_hold 3x25s_each rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_doorway_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower Body Strength + Lateral Control":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 4x8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          lateral_step_down_low_box controlled 3x8_each rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          seated_hamstring_curl 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          cable_lateral_walk 3x10m_each rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 3m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body Strength (Progress)":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles 6x2 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          step_up_moderate_box controlled 4x6_each rpe 7..8 rest 150 seconds
          nordic_curl_assisted 4x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          paloff_press_walkout 3x10_each rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_barbell_press 5x3 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          weighted_pullup_or_assisted 5x3 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          single_arm_cable_row_split_stance 3x8_each rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_dumbbell_press_seated 3x8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 3x45s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower Body Strength + Lateral Control":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_hip_thrust 5x5 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lateral_step_down_low_box controlled 3x8_each rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          seated_hamstring_curl 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          cable_lateral_walk 4x10m_each rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          tibialis_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 3m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body Strength (Tempo)":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles_tempo_3s_down 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          step_up_moderate_box slow_lower 4x6_each rpe 7..8 rest 150 seconds
          nordic_curl_assisted 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          standing_calf_raise_pause 4x10 rpe 7..8 rest 60 seconds
          paloff_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_barbell_press 6x2 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          weighted_pullup_or_assisted 6x2 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          chest_supported_row 3x8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_dumbbell_press_seated 3x8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          side_plank 3x35s_each rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_doorway_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower Body Strength + Lateral Control":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_hip_thrust 5x4 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 4x6 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          lateral_step_down_low_box controlled 3x10_each rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          seated_hamstring_curl 4x10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          cable_lateral_walk 4x12m_each rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tibialis_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 3m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Deload Lower Emphasis":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles 3x3 rpe 6..7 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 3x6 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          step_up_low_box controlled 2x8_each rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_hamstring_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Deload":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_barbell_press 3x4 rpe 6..7 rest 150 seconds
          assisted_pullup 3x6 rpe 6..7 rest 150 seconds
          chest_supported_row 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_face_pull 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30s rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Deload + Balance":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_hip_thrust 3x4 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 2x8 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          lateral_step_down_low_box 2x8_each rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          tibialis_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          single_leg_balance_reach 2x6_each rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
  PHASE "Phase 3: Max Strength + Ski Prep" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body Max Strength":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles 6x2 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 5x4 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          step_up_moderate_box controlled 4x5_each rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          nordic_curl_assisted 4x4 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          standing_calf_raise_pause 4x8 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          paloff_press_walkout 3x10_each rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body Strength + Posture":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 5x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          weighted_pullup_or_assisted 5x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          chest_supported_row 3x6 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          prone_y_raises 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_extension_mobility 3m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower Body Strength + Endurance":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_hip_thrust 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 4x6 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          lateral_step_down_low_box controlled 3x8_each rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          seated_hamstring_curl 4x8 rpe 8..9 rest 90 seconds
          sled_push_moderate 5x25m rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          tibialis_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 3m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body Max Strength (Cluster)":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles_cluster 4x1..1..1 rpe 9 rest 20 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 6x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          step_up_moderate_box slow_lower 4x5_each rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          nordic_curl_assisted 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          standing_calf_raise_pause 4x8 rpe 8..9 rest 60 seconds
          paloff_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 6x2 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          weighted_pullup_or_assisted 6x2 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          single_arm_cable_row_split_stance 3x6_each rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          side_plank 3x40s_each rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower Body Strength + Endurance":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_hip_thrust 6x2 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 5x4 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          lateral_step_down_low_box controlled 3x10_each rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          seated_hamstring_curl 4x8 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          sled_push_moderate 6x25m rpe 7..8 rest 75 seconds
          tibialis_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 3m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body Strength (Taper)":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles 4x2 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 4x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          step_up_moderate_box 3x5_each rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          nordic_curl_assisted 3x3 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          paloff_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Taper":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 4x2 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          weighted_pullup_or_assisted 4x2 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          chest_supported_row 2x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 2x4 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          plank 2x40s rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Ski-Specific Strength + Endurance (Low-Impact)":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_hip_thrust 4x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 4x6 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          wall_sit_partial 4x30s rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          sled_push_moderate 6x30m rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_band_walk 3x12m_each rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          tibialis_raise 3x15 rpe 6..7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 3m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Consolidation Strength":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles 3x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 3x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          step_up_moderate_box controlled 3x5_each rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          seated_hamstring_curl 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise_pause 3x8 rpe 7..8 rest 60 seconds
          paloff_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Consolidation":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_barbell_press 4x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          weighted_pullup_or_assisted 4x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          chest_supported_row 3x8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          side_plank 3x40s_each rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation_drill 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Ski Prep Strength + Capacity (Low-Impact)":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_hip_thrust 3x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press high_foot_position 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          wall_sit_partial 4x30s rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          sled_push_moderate 6x30m rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_band_walk 3x12m_each rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          tibialis_raise 3x15 rpe 6..7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
